versionPairs.description: A real esbuild 0.27.2 `--bundle --format=cjs --platform=node` build (unminified) of the shared node-app source (test/e2e/fixtures/node-app) — the layout real Node CLIs ship (pnpm's dist/pnpm.cjs, wrangler's wrangler-dist/cli.js): esbuild's helpers at the TOP LEVEL of a CommonJS file, Node's own module wrapper implicit, no wrapper function in the text. KNOWN GAP (plugin-spec I25, the P9 bundle layout): --split fails with no recognizable bundle wrapper. v1.1.0 perturbs the last dep (adds tripled), the late module's output and the lazy stamp.
